race.comment: ORSUM (5) solid return when he chipped away late from the wide gate to secure second over 1000m at Dubbo. His peak runs are usually second up and he maps to get the gun run. PANTA RHEI (3) has her hoof on the till fifth up despite drawing out. Gave her all from the outside gate with a tenacious on-pace second over 1000m at this track with the 60kg. Similar set-up again and stays in the mix. FAST BLUE (10) resumes. Was a month between runs with a struggling third over 1350m at Beaumont Newcastle last March. Worth thought. LAIZABOUT (15) warmed up late with a respectable ninth in Highway grade over 1000m at Randwick. Looking for this trip and ticks a few boxes with the claim.
